record.question: The MRO is the ________ of Medical Record Committee.
record.explanation: Answer C: Secretary. In common hospital committee arrangements, the Medical Record Officer serves as secretary to the Medical Record Committee, coordinating records and minutes. Source/context note: Role depends on local committee terms of reference. Reference: https://svimstpt.ap.nic.in/about/comit_files/mrc.pdf; https://www.aiimsmadurai.edu.in/committees.php. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
